briefs.title: Tax-Relief Momentum Builds in Michigan While Rescheduling and Psilocybin Push Forward Nationally
briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.top: Michigan operators are getting real signals of relief — a GOP gubernatorial nominee's tax-repeal pledge now has industry backing, new stores are opening from tribal land to Ann Arbor, and Michigan's rock-bottom prices are pulling customers from Ohio and Illinois. Nationally, Compass Pathways is staffing up for a 2027 psilocybin launch and the DEA's rescheduling pause is a procedural speed bump, not a dead end, while MSO consolidation keeps accelerating.
